findings.text: follow-on: ROUTES is built from nested.PARTITION_ROUTE and nested.OVERRIDE_ENV and named_routes reads the same constants out of the produced text, so the guard proves the refusal and the digest name whatever those constants hold, not that the partition phrase still reads as a partition route — an edit to the constant's value would keep the test green while the route name stopped describing a separate job.
